o1: Predicted to enable 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 3-kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer entry; determination of adult lifespan; regulation of synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction; defense response to bacterium; and innate immune response. Acts upstream of or within embryonic body morphogenesis. Located in cytoplasm and non-motile cilium. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex. Is expressed in anchor cell; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and pharyngeal-intestinal valve. Is part of insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling pathway; let-502/mel-11 pathway. Used to study enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including CLOVES syndrome; breast cancer (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); primary immunodeficiency disease (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including PIK3CB, PIK3CD, and PIK3CG.
